name: console-04-agents
prompt: Turn this into a different screen of the same web app: the Smart-Clearance super-admin console, shown edge to edge with no browser window. Keep the reference's visual system exactly: pale sage-white background, the frosted left sidebar, white cards with thin hairline edges and soft shadows, the deep green brand colour, the amber accent, the heavy grotesque page title and the clean sans interface text. Replace every piece of the reference's content in the whole main area, top to bottom, including the lower half. Layout: 1) Left sidebar: the green rounded-square S logo with "Smart-Clearance" and a small grey "Console" under it; navigation items "Overview", "Clients" (selected), "Agents", "Connectors", "Plans", "Staff", "Audit log"; at the bottom "Neha Kulkarni, Super admin" with a small round portrait. 2) Client header: an orange rounded tile with a white letter m, the title "Munchly Foods", "munchly.smartclearance.com" in monospace, a green "Live" pill; under it tabs "Agents" (selected), "Supply chain", "Channels & rules", "People", "Integrations", "Plan", "Audit". 3) The agent pipeline fills the left two thirds of the page as a tall vertical tracker: a thin green line runs down the left with eleven stops, and beside each stop a wide white row card: "Data · maps the stock export · daily 08:30", "Watcher · finds batches at risk · daily 09:00", "Vision · reads the label photo · confidence 0.90", "Valuer · prices five exits", "Router · splits the batch", then an amber-outlined row "Priya approves · one tap, always", then "Lister · ExpireSoon in the distributor's name", "Outreach · kiranas, Hindi first", "Negotiator · floor ₹13.50", "Paperwork · invoice, e-way bill, credit note", "Impact · BRSR ledger". Each row ends with a small segmented control "Suggest | Ask | Act". The Negotiator row is highlighted as selected. 4) The right third is a white side panel for the selected agent, titled "Negotiator", with rows "Floor ₹13.50", "Counter up to 2 times", "Token 15%", "Hide lots inside Munchly territories" with a green switch, "Last run 10:05 · countered ₹14.20", and a dark green "Save" button at the bottom. Crisp flat interface; all text legible.
postprocess: WebP; the PNG original stays local in .impeccable/mocks/
